name: edit-across-font-boundary
request: The kubectl line should target namespace staging-eu.
expected: Line reads `Kubectl rollout restart deploy/api -n staging-eu` with Courier New 10pt still on `Kubectl rollout restart deploy/api`; `Deploy to staging` untouched.
explain: The first paragraph is a command line. Its first part, 'Kubectl rollout restart deploy/api', is written in a typewriter font (Courier New, small), and the rest is in the normal font. We asked gdoc to change the namespace at the end from 'staging' to 'staging-eu'. The text changed correctly, but the whole line is now in the normal font: the typewriter font is gone, even though the edit did not touch those words. Compare the fonts of the first paragraph in the two tabs.
